requested_by: owner 2026-10-26: replace gap-size tiers with three layers ranked by actual quality - Best / Second best / Third best
independent_of: registry/learned_tiers/registration_v1.json + amendment_v1_1.json (a different study: learned tiers over ALL candidates with fixed EV cut-offs; neither registration amends the other)

score.p_win: per track (standard / new_format, never pooled) L2 logistic, C=0.5, standardised inputs: logit(fair market p) [two-sided de-vig where the opposite price exists, else 1/odds/1.08], logit(model p) - logit(fair p), odds>=3.00 flag, league rating as known at the time (sum pnl/(n+50) over tips played strictly before), market dummies (BTTS/OVER15/OVER35 vs OU25), Under dummy, market x fair and market x gap interactions
score.fit: refitted each predict run on the frozen first-sight seed (season to 2026-10-26) + shadow rows the ledgers have settled, matches played strictly before the UTC day; >=150 settled tips per track

definitions.TERCILE: per tip day within track x market, ranked by first-sight score: rank percentile (r-0.5)/n < 1/3 BEST, < 2/3 SECOND, else THIRD; ties by row key
definitions.FIXED: score >= cut_hi BEST, >= cut_lo SECOND, else THIRD, with the per-cell cut-offs below (learned on the 2026-08-31..2026-10-04 discovery window)

layers.evaluator_note: FIXED is written at first sight (layer_fixed column). TERCILE is recomputed by the evaluator from the logged first-sight scores of each tip day; no outcome enters either.

data.file: v9 output/quality_tier_shadow.csv (FirstSightStore, digest sidecar, earliest row wins)
data.eligible_rows: ledger_generated_at >= 2026-10-27T00:00:00Z AND lag_min <= 60 AND observed_at < kickoff_utc AND quality_version == 'qt_v1' AND p_win present
data.unit: one row per fixture x market (match_day, home_team, away_team, market)
data.results: WIN/LOSS from the v9 ledgers; flat 1u P&L at the LOGGED first-sight odds; VOID/PUSH/postponed excluded
data.cells: track x market: new_format|OU25, new_format|BTTS, new_format|OVER15, new_format|OVER35, standard|OU25, standard|BTTS, standard|OVER15, standard|OVER35 - never pooled

minimums_per_cell.note: below any minimum the cell is ACCRUING (or INSUFFICIENT if the season ends first); no verdict, no peeking-based stop

primary_metric: Best - Third flat ROI difference (pp), matchday block bootstrap (10,000 resamples, days resampled jointly for both layers), one-sided p of (Best - Third <= 0)
secondary_metrics: monotonicity: ROI Best > Second > Third (point estimates) and Spearman(layer rank, pnl)
certified-close CLV by layer (close within 30 min of kickoff)
Brier of p_win vs the de-vigged price on the same rows
the same primary + monotonicity test on the FIRST-SIGHT gap tiers (SNIPER - VALUABLE) of the same rows
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the cells that reach the minimums, q < 0.10

statuses.INSUFFICIENT: the season ended before the minimums
statuses.FORWARD_SUPPORTED: minimums met AND Best > Second > Third AND BH q < 0.10 AND Best - Third larger than the gap tiers' SNIPER - VALUABLE on the same rows
statuses.REJECTED: minimums met and any FORWARD_SUPPORTED condition fails - the cell keeps ONE layer ('Tip')
statuses.CONFIRMED: NEVER assigned by this registration or its evaluator

switch_on: A FORWARD_SUPPORTED cell may be PROPOSED to the owner; production changes only with explicit owner approval, and stakes may follow layers only as a re-weighting inside the cell's existing budget (never a PAPER->real change, never above bankroll-policy caps).
historical_result: DISCOVERY ONLY, cannot trigger anything: on the 2026-10-05..10-25 holdout every cell was ONE_LAYER (ORDER_FAILS or INSUFFICIENT); see the v9 report.
frozen: features, C, MIN_TRAIN, league shrinkage, cut-offs, chosen definitions, eligibility, minimums, metric and statuses are not changed after forward data is seen; any change is registration_v2 with a new forward window
